profile.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro is DeepSeek's 1.6T parameter (49B activated) MoE model supporting 512K token context. It introduces a hybrid attention architecture combining Compressed Sparse Attention and Heavily Compressed Attention, requiring only 27% of inference FLOPs and 10% of KV cache compared to V3.2 at million-token context. Pre-trained on 32T+ tokens with Muon optimizer and a two-stage post-training pipeline, V4 Pro delivers three configurable reasoning modes and strong performance across coding (93.5% LiveCodeBench), reasoning (90.1% GPQA Diamond), and agentic tasks (80.6% SWE-Bench Verified). MIT licensed.
